# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Wednesday, November 18, 2026

Morning edition for Wednesday, 18 November 2026 (IST). Filed late, after the 07:00 run did not fire. Covers Tuesday 17 Nov to early Wednesday. Stock and index figures are Tuesday 17 Nov closes. IBJA's 18 Nov AM session was not posted at writing time, so the IBJA rows are the 17 Nov PM session. AGLOC's 18 Nov block is live.

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Gold-loan NBFCs ask RBI to review capital and risk-weight rules at Kochi summit
The Federation of Gold Loan Companies (FGLOC) held its first Gold Summit in Kochi on Tuesday 17 November and said it will approach RBI for recognition as a Self-Regulatory Organisation (SRO). The industry has asked RBI to review three things. These are representations, not rule changes: the 12% Tier-I capital requirement for gold-loan NBFCs, against 10% for other lending businesses; the 100% risk weight assigned to gold-loan exposures; and the LTV rules.

George Alexander Muthoot, executive vice-chairman of Muthoot Finance (a listed peer, and a separate company from Muthoot Fincorp), said of the capital ask: "It is not a big ask. The same customer, the same gold and the same currency are involved, whether the loan is given by a bank or an NBFC. Banks have a much larger share of the gold-loan market. There should be a level playing field." He also said more than 75% of the gold-loan sector is represented by FGLOC, and urged smaller lenders to join.

On the SRO plan, Pinaki Nath Banerjee, CEO-designate of FGLOC, said the immediate priority is to expand membership before approaching RBI for SRO status. FGLOC has 23 members, with five more still deciding, and is considering changing the shareholding requirement in its articles so that members can join without taking equity. Banerjee acknowledged an existing SRO for NBFCs: "There is an existing SRO for NBFCs. However, the NBFC sector is extremely large, with approximately 9,075 registered companies."

Banerjee put the organised gold-loan market at ₹19–20 lakh crore: ₹5–6 lakh crore with NBFCs and ₹14–15 lakh crore with banks. RBI data cited by Mint show NBFC loans against jewellery up 69% year on year to ₹3.64 trillion at end-August, and the banks' figure up 83% to ₹5.59 trillion.

The summit also brought warnings on growth and auctions. Mayank Sharma, president-lending at IIFL Finance, said: "At the current gold price, there will be a greater focus on customer collections and interest collections." He expects a significant rise in gold auctions this year once prices stabilise over a longer period, and said: "Consequently, we expect growth to remain muted in Q3," as festive and wedding spending and lower prices pressure borrowers' repayment capacity. Banerjee said repayment challenges have emerged after the correction, though fresh loan demand is healthy, and that growth will continue but not at the same magnitude.

Lenders are moving away from short-term bullet repayments towards monthly or quarterly interest and longer tenures, after RBI's revised gold-loan directions, Economic Times reports.

Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Muthoot Fincorp is a gold-loan NBFC, so the asks bear on its sector. They are requests to RBI, not rules, so nothing changes for Muthoot Fincorp from this summit. The sources do not say whether Muthoot Fincorp is an FGLOC member.
Sources: [Mint (Subhana Shaikh, 17 Nov)](https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking/gold-loan-nbfcs-seek-rbi-relief-on-capital-norms-as-new-rules-raise-npa-concerns-11794919898824.html) · [ET (Shilpy Sinha, updated 18 Nov 01:58 IST)](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/gold-loan-nbfcs-seek-lower-capital-requirements-and-risk-weights-call-for-level-playing-field-with-banks/articleshow/135939995.cms) · [BusinessLine (V Sajeev Kumar, 17 Nov)](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/fgloc-to-seek-rbi-recognition-as-sro-for-gold-loan-nbfcs/article71711421.ece) · [PTI via The Week (17 Nov)](https://www.theweek.in/wire-updates/business/2026/11/17/gold-loan-industry-braces-for-slower-growth-higher-auctions-amid-gold-price-correction.html)

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

Indian shares rose on Tuesday. The Nifty 50 closed at 25,387.40 (+0.38%), Nifty Bank at 62,273.25 (+1.13%) and Nifty Financial Services at 28,195.00 (+0.64%). The Sensex closed at 82,532.19, up 427.40 points (+0.52%). Foreign investors were net buyers of ₹4,195.38 crore and domestic institutions of ₹196.93 crore (both provisional). Among the listed peers, Muthoot Finance fell 1.01% to ₹2,749.00, Manappuram 2.37% to ₹296.60 and IIFL Finance 2.45% to ₹636.40. Shriram Finance rose 0.45% to ₹982.85, Bajaj Finance 1.00% to ₹1,121.10, and Muthoot Microfin, a group company, 3.48% to ₹168.92.

### Update: Spot gold near $3,850 on Tuesday, down 0.35%
Spot gold was $3,849.59 an ounce at 4:30 p.m. ET on Tuesday 17 November, down 0.35% on the day, according to USA Today. globalgoldprices described the close as its lowest finish since late September 2025. AGLOC's 85% LTV ceiling for 18 Nov is ₹10,448 a gram, ₹60 below the 17 Nov figure (see Gold and LTV below).

Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a lower gold price lowers the per-gram value of pledged collateral, so loans written close to an LTV ceiling have a thinner cushion. AGLOC's ceilings for 18 Nov are lower in all three LTV bands.

latest_circulars.summary: RBI cancelled the certificates of registration of 49 NBFCs under Section 45-IA(6) of the RBI Act, through orders dated 1 to 29 October 2026; 43 of them have registered offices in West Bengal, 41 in Kolkata. latest_circulars.title: RBI deputy governor: microfinance FOIR cap stays at 50%, income limit under review
latest_circulars.summary: This is a speech, not a circular, so no rule changes. latest_circulars.title: SEBI aligns FATCA/CRS reporting with the Income-Tax Rules, 2026
latest_circulars.summary: SEBI told registered intermediaries that qualify as Reporting Financial Institutions to follow Rules 238 to 240 and Form 166 of the Income-Tax Rules, 2026, which replaced the 1962 Rules from 1 April 2026. They must update self-certification capture, controlling-person roles, account classification and Form 166 XML generation, and upload FATCA/CRS certifications to the KRAs.
latest_circulars.impact: Muthoot Fincorp is not a SEBI intermediary. Reporting financial institutions outside SEBI's remit report under the same Income-Tax rules and Form 166, so the field changes SEBI lists apply to them as well.

latest_circulars.title: RBI consolidates its Domestic Money Transfer Directions
latest_circulars.summary: RBI issued the Reserve Bank of India (Domestic Money Transfer) Directions, 2026, which consolidate the existing DMT instructions for banks and authorised payment system operators and take effect immediately. Cash pay-outs stay capped at ₹10,000 a transaction and ₹25,000 a month per beneficiary, and walk-in remitters can send up to ₹5,000 a transaction and ₹25,000 a month through BCs, with registration on a verified mobile number and a self-certified OVD.
latest_circulars.impact: not addressed to NBFCs; it applies to an NBFC only where it acts for a bank or payment operator. The velocity checks and alerts on unusual credit spurts in paras 15–17 describe controls also relevant to cash-heavy lending.
